  1. Description

Annotation Interface OnVirtualThread

@SubscribingAnnotation(executor=VirtualThreadExecutor.class) @Documented @Retention(CLASS) @Target(METHOD) public @interface OnVirtualThread
Subscribes a method as @Subscribe does, but has each of its events delivered on a new virtual thread, with VirtualThreadExecutor. 
class Indexer {
    @OnVirtualThread
    void onPlaced(OrderPlaced event) {
        ...
    }
}

The events reach the method in no particular order, and the method can run on several threads at once: the listener must be thread-safe. As for any subscribing annotation, EventBus.Builder.executor(Class, java.util.concurrent.Executor) can give the bus another executor for it.
